verdict.rationale: Omarchy publishes an official manual covering installation (write the ISO to USB and answer five questions, plus dual-boot and unattended-install guides, and a VM to try it first). The manual also teaches the desktop: the launcher, the Omarchy Menu, terminal and browser hotkeys, tiling/layout toggles, and a Super+K keybinding overview. Community users report the install as uncomplicated and quick, with one ISO failure on a Chromebook. Missing for 10: evidence of step-by-step install walkthrough content beyond summaries, an interactive or guided first-run tutorial for learning the keyboard-driven interface, and switcher-focused onboarding for the Hyprland learning curve.
